title: Glyph-O-Tron
description: Reverse engineer tangled alien blueprints by spotting each hidden glyph among the decoys in this free puzzle game you play in your browser.
about:
Glyph-O-Tron hands you a glowing alien blueprint made of five overlapping neon glyphs, all drifting and tangled together. Below it sits a row of parts: the real pieces of the blueprint mixed with convincing decoys. Pick every genuine glyph and the blueprint dissolves piece by piece, spinning you into the next level.

It is a pure pattern-matching test that gets sneakier as you go. Each level adds more corners and curves to every shape, level 7 brings extra decoys, some levels paint everything in a single color, and from level 3 the machine starts to malfunction, blurring, inverting or graying out the blueprint for a few seconds. Two wrong picks on the same level and the universe is lost, so every choice counts.

Originally created by Nathan Blenke for js13kGames 2015.
howToPlay: Study the blueprint at the top and find the five glyphs it is made of among the parts in the grid. Tap or click a part to pick it: correct picks score 50 points and vanish from the blueprint. Find all five to clear the level, but two wrong picks on the same level end the game.

controls.action: Pick a part by its number

tips: Match the color first, then compare the shape: a decoy can share a color but never the exact outline.
Watch for pieces disappearing from the blueprint after each correct pick, since what is left gets easier to read.
During a device malfunction you can simply wait a few seconds for the blueprint to return to normal.
On single-color levels, look for distinctive corners and closed loops rather than overall size.

faq.question: Is Glyph-O-Tron free to play?
faq.answer: Yes, Glyph-O-Tron is completely free and runs right in your browser with nothing to install.

faq.question: Can I play Glyph-O-Tron on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, just tap the parts to pick them. The layout adapts to portrait and landscape screens, although parts are larger on tablets and in landscape.

faq.question: What is the device malfunction?
faq.answer: From level 3 the machine occasionally glitches and blurs, inverts or grays out the blueprint for a few seconds, making the glyphs harder to recognize.
